examples.title: Action group
examples.markup: <tmt-ui-action label="Approve" variant="primary"></tmt-ui-action> <tmt-ui-action label="Decline" variant="secondary"></tmt-ui-action> <tmt-ui-action label="Cancel" variant="text"></tmt-ui-action>

notes: The Browser action presents one primary action per group, with secondary or text actions beside it. Disabled and busy states communicate when the action cannot run.
